name: Thank You Proven Theme Fixture Doctrine
purpose: Protect working Thank You KKs while preventing Thank You from being mistaken for the universal K-KUT model.
core_rule: Thank You is one proven personal/theme KK family used as a BIC proof fixture. It is not the universal K-KUT model, not the only sellable theme, and not the catalog architecture.
do_not_change_without_specific_audio_reg: prebuild BIC gate reliance on proven Thank You fixture
limits: Thank You must not be treated as the only Personal theme.
Thank You must not define all K-KUT buyer lanes.
Thank You must not block generated public option bridge records.
Thank You must not be used as evidence that only Mother’s Day products exist.
future_target: Create a neutral Theme KK fixture model after public bridge records, Find filtering, and buyer-safe routes remain stable.
